decisions: Constitution text: G.O. 5.908 Ext. of 19 Feb 2009 (the latest full official printing, ordered by Enmienda N° 1 art. 2), read from the text layer of the copy hosted by the Instituto Nacional de Estadística (ine.gob.ve). The TSJ and Asamblea Nacional copies of 5.908 and 5.453 are image scans and this machine has no OCR, so they were not used for text.

Version 1 (from 1999-12-30) is the 5.908 body text with the original wording of arts. 160, 162, 174, 192 and 230 (which the reprint keeps, each followed by a '(Ver Enmienda N° 1 ...)' note, per Const. art. 341.5). It is cross-checked word by word against the Asamblea Nacional's text of 1999 (a text-layer PDF). The TSJ's HTML transcription labelled G.O. 5.453 differs in wording from both in more than 80 articles and is not used.

The original publication (G.O. 36.860, 30 Dec 1999) was reprinted 'por error material del ente emisor' in G.O. 5.453 Ext. (24 Mar 2000). No text-layer copy of 36.860 was found, so the corrections are not a separate version: version 1 carries the corrected wording from 1999-12-30 (its in-force day, Disposición final única).

Version 2 (from 2009-02-19, the day of publication; the Enmienda names no other date, Código Civil art. 1) replaces the operative text of the five articles with the Enmienda's wording; the '(Ver Enmienda ...)' notes are dropped from the text.
The Constitution of 1999 is credited as a referendum (approved 15 Dec 1999, proclaimed 20 Dec 1999); the Enmienda N° 1 as a referendum (approved 15 Feb 2009).

One file per article, transitional provision, derogatory and final provision; the Preamble in preambulo.md; the closing approval paragraph in promulgacion.md; the headings of titles, chapters and sections, in order, in titulos.md. The lists of signatories are omitted. The Exposición de Motivos (in G.O. 5.453, not in 5.908) is not normative and is not included.

The INE copy of G.O. 5.908 lacks some lines of text (mostly the last line of a page; the words are not in the PDF). parse.py aligns it word by word with the Asamblea Nacional text and restores 12 gaps from it, in units art-033, art-049, art-089, art-156, art-178, art-187, art-270, art-293, art-332, disp-transitoria-03, disp-transitoria-04. Every restored passage is listed below. The remaining differences between the two are spellings of compound words ('politicoterritorial' in 5.908, 'político territorial' in the AN text) and AN typos ('postrado', 'contenciosa electoral', 'auditoria'); the 5.908 spelling is kept.

Restored in art-033 from the AN text, after 'tener domicilio en Venezuela con residencia': 'ininterrumpida de, por lo menos, diez años inmediatamente anteriores a la fecha de la respectiva solicitud.'.

Restored in art-049 from the AN text, after 'por un tribunal competente, independiente': 'e imparcial establecido con anterioridad. Quien no hable castellano, o no pueda comunicarse de manera verbal, tiene derecho a un intérprete.'.

Restored in art-089 from the AN text, after 'que implique renuncia o menoscabo de estos': 'derechos. Sólo es posible la transacción y convenimiento al término de la relación laboral, de conformidad con los requisitos que establezca la ley.'.
Restored in art-156 from the AN text, after 'y sobre transacciones inmobiliarias, cuya': 'recaudación y control corresponda a los Municipios, de conformidad con esta Constitución.'.

Restored in art-178 from the AN text, after 'a la adolescencia y a la tercera edad;': 'educación preescolar, servicios de integración familiar de la persona con discapacidad al desarrollo comunitario, actividades e instalaciones culturales y deportivas; servicios de prevención y protección, vigilancia y control de los bienes y las actividades relativas a las materias de la competencia municipal.'.
Restored in art-187 from the AN text, after 'serán presentadas por el Ejecutivo Nacional': 'en el transcurso del tercer trimestre del primer año de cada período constitucional.'.

Restored in art-270 from the AN text, after 'disciplinaria. El Comité de Postulaciones': 'Judiciales estará integrado por representantes de los diferentes sectores de la sociedad, de conformidad con lo que establezca la ley.'.
Restored in art-293 from the AN text, after 'del Tribunal Supremo de Justicia. Las': 'corporaciones, entidades y organizaciones aquí referidas cubrirán los costos de sus procesos eleccionarios.'.
Restored in art-332 from the AN text, after 'y administración de emergencias de carácter': 'civil.'.
Restored in disp-transitoria-03 from the AN text: 'ara' is 'Para' (first letter missing in the INE copy).

Restored in disp-transitoria-04 from the AN text, after 'diez años. Durante este lapso, mientras no': 'entre en vigencia la reforma de la ley seguirá aplicándose de forma transitoria el régimen de la prestación de antigüedad establecido en la Ley Orgánica del Trabajo vigente. Asimismo, contemplará un conjunto de normas integrales que regulen la jornada laboral y propendan a su disminución progresiva, en los términos previstos en los acuerdos y convenios de la Organización Internacional del Trabajo suscritos por la República.'.

Restored in disp-transitoria-04 from the AN text, after 'de la República en lo que se refiere a la': 'legalidad, sinceridad, oportunidad, eficacia y eficiencia de la gestión administrativa del Banco Central de Venezuela.'.

Paragraphs are rebuilt from the PDF layout: wrapped lines are joined, page numbers dropped, a blank line ends a paragraph only after . : ; or ), and numbered/lettered items start their own line. Spellings are kept as printed in G.O. 5.908.

Constitución de 1961: text from the TSJ's text-layer PDF of the 1961 Constitution as reprinted after Enmienda N° 2 (Wayback capture 20110125000458 of tsj.gov.ve/legislacion/constitucion1961.pdf). The gazettes themselves (TSJ historico PDFs 26461_GO, 1585_GOE, 32696_GOE) are scans and were not read; the in-force days are the promulgation days printed in the text ('Ejecútese' 23 Jan 1961, 'Cúmplase' 11 May 1973 and 26 Mar 1983), taken as the days of publication in the Gaceta Oficial.

Constitución de 1961: its enmiendas are separate texts published after the Constitution with a note under the articles they concern (art. 245.6); they do not change the articles' words. Each enmienda's operative articles are units of their own (enmienda-01-art-001, enmienda-02-art-001 to -008), added on its day; the reprint's notes '* Ver Enmienda ...' and 'Cumplida (ver Enmienda número 2 ...)' under fulfilled transitional provisions are dropped from the text.

Constitución de 1961: arts. 191 and 192 are missing from the TSJ transcription (art. 190 runs straight into Capítulo III and art. 193), and no other machine-readable official copy was found, so they are absent from every version. The Disposiciones Transitorias (a separate text sanctioned on the same day, art. 251) are included as disp-transitoria-01 to -23. The signatories are omitted.

Constitución de 1961: repealed on 1999-12-30 by the Disposición derogatoria única of the Constitution of 1999; that commit removes every file of constitucion-1961/ and is credited to the Constitution of 1999.
